title: Crna kapa-balaklava sa flisom
description:
Crna kapa balaklava sa flis podstavom: kapa i balaklava u jednom komadu, za trčanje, vožnju bicikla i rad napolju na hladnom vetru.

Model je zamišljen za ljude koji provode više od pola sata napolju: trče, voze bicikl, rade napolju ili čekaju prevoz na promaji. Flis podstava je mekana uz kožu i čuva toplotu dok se telo kreće, a deo za vrat ne klizi tokom aktivnosti jer je kroj nastavljen na kapu.

Balaklava se po potrebi navlači i preko lica, a u toplijem delu dana spusti se samo oko vrata, bez skidanja kape. Crna boja ne ističe prašinu i deluje neutralno uz jakne u različitim bojama. Model iz Tamir radnje, za svakodnevnu zimsku upotrebu.
en_description:
Black balaclava hat with a fleece lining: hat and neck tube cut as one piece, made for running, cycling and working outside in the cold.

It suits anyone who spends long cold mornings outdoors, because nothing shifts while you move. The fleece sits close to the skin and holds warmth while the body is active, and the neck portion stays put since it is sewn into the cap.

When the face needs shielding you pull it up; when the day warms you drop it around the neck without taking the hat off. Black hides road dust and pairs easily with jackets in any colour. An everyday winter model from the Tamir shop in Serbia.

title: Siva kapa-balaklava za grad
description:
Siva kapa balaklava za hladne dane u gradu: pokriva uši, bradu i vrat bez marame, a u toplom prostoru spušta se do ovratnika.

Umesto kape i marame dovoljan je jedan komad koji ne pravi debele slojeve pod jaknom. Kroj je nastavljen na kapu, tako da deo za vrat ostaje na mestu — ne krivi se i ne mota kada kapuljača pređe preko glave. Flis podstava je mekana uz kožu i ne iritira vrat.

Kada uđete u topli prostor, balaklava se spusti do ovratnika, a kapa ostaje na glavi, bez premotavanja marame. Siva je neutralna uz tamne i svetlije jakne, a model se lako pere i zadržava oblik. Dostupan u Tamir radnji.
en_description:
Grey balaclava hat with fleece, made for city winters: it covers ears, chin and neck, then slides down the moment you step indoors.

Bus stops, crossings, quick walks between heated rooms. Instead of juggling a hat and a scarf, one piece covers the ears, chin and neck without adding bulk under a coat. Because the balaclava is built into the hat, the neck tube keeps its position — no twisting when a hood goes over it, no readjusting at every corner.

Step into a café or an office and you simply slide the tube down to your collar; the hat stays on your head. The soft fleece lining feels gentle on the skin all day, and grey keeps its shape after a wash.

title: Crna prelazna kapa sa flisom
description:
Crna prelazna kapa sa flisom: tanja podstava za jesen, zimu i vetrovito proleće — greje ispod kapuljače, a ne pregreva glavu.

Kapa za ljude koji se na hladno spremaju u slojevima: ispod kapuljače jakne, na kiši i vetru, bez vune koja žuži. Tanji flis prekida vetar koji hladi glavu, ali glava diše kada temperatura poraste nekoliko stepeni iznad deset.

Kroj je kraći, dobro prianja uz čelo i pokriva uši, a ravna kapa ne pravi izbočinu ispod kapuljače niti se gužva u džepu ili ranču. Crna ide uz sve iz garderobera, a kapa se koristi i u proleće kada je vetrovito. Drži oblik posle pranja, bez rastezanja.
en_description:
Black transitional cap with a thin fleece lining for autumn, winter and windy spring: it lives under your hood and never adds bulk.

Whoever handles cold in layers already knows where this cap sits: under a jacket hood, out in drizzle and wind, with no wool to itch. The fleece cuts the wind chill that finds an uncovered head, yet the crown stays breathable once the thermometer climbs above ten.

The cut is low on the ears and flat on the crown, so it adds nothing under a hood, then folds small enough for a coat pocket when the day turns mild. Black disappears against every colour in a winter wardrobe, from navy parkas to grey coats.

title: Siva prelazna kapa sa flisom
description:
Siva prelazna kapa sa flisom: za jesen i rano proleće, kad je zimska kapa previše, a bez nje vetar probada uši.

Model za deo godine kada je ujutru hladno, a u dva toplo. Flis podstava je tanka, drži topao vazduh uz glavu, ali glava diše kada sunce ojača. Nizak kroj pokriva uši i dobro prianja uz glavu, pa kapa staje ispod kapuljače i ne diže se sama.

Siva dobro izgleda uz tamnu jaknu, ali i uz svetlije nijanse — boja se ne takmiči sa ostatkom kombinacije. Kada dan otopli, kapa se sklapa u gotovo ništa u džepu. Model iz Tamir radnje, za jesen, zimu i prve tople dane.
en_description:
Grey transitional cap with a thin fleece lining, for shoulder-season days when a winter hat is too much and bare ears catch cold.

Mornings are cold, afternoons mild, and this cut bridges the gap. The lining is thin fleece, so it takes the chill off without making your head sweat once the sun climbs — the cap you wear on the school run, the evening bike ride or the walk the dog insists on.

Slim enough to disappear under a hood, it sits low on the ears and flat on the crown. Grey matches dark and lighter coats alike, and when the day finally turns warm it slips into a pocket.

title: Crni muški buff sa flisom
description:
Muški crni buff sa flisom: grejač za vrat, traka za glavu ili zaštita od vetra u jednom komadu, bez kopči i bez vezivanja.

Tokom dana jedan komad menja ulogu četiri puta. Na putu ka poslu to je grejač za vrat, navučen preko nosa postaje zaštita od vetra i prašine na biciklu, a ujutru na stazi pretvara se u traku za glavu i na pauzi može sići do ručnih zglobova. Flis podstava je tamo gde najviše prija: oko vrata i ušiju, bez viška ispod ovratnika jakne.

Crna je najlakša za kombinovanje sa ostatkom zimske opreme i ne pokazuje tragove upotrebe. Lako se navlači i skida, a kad se uđe u topao prostor spušta se do ovratnika. Drži oblik i posle mnogo pranja — praktična stvar iz Tamir radnje.
en_title: Black Men's Buff with Fleece Lining
en_description:
Black men's buff with fleece lining: one tube that works as a neck gaiter, headband or face cover through cold days, with no clips.

It is the default pick among our fleece-lined buffs for a simple reason: it matches every piece of winter gear you already own, and the lining does the quiet work of making cold mornings bearable. Gaiter for the commute, pulled up as a wind and dust barrier on the bike, headband for a cold run, even a wrist wipe between intervals.

Fleece inside adds warmth exactly where the wind bites: the neck and the sides of the face. Black stays looking new through dust, exhaust and wool collars, then slides down to the collar when you step indoors.

title: Sivi muški buff sa flisom
description:
Sivi muški buff sa flisom: staje ispod ovratnika jakne, greje vrat na stanici i navlači se preko ušiju kada vetar ojača.

Model za svakodnevnu vožnju i za one koji ga navlače i skinu pet puta pre podne. Flis greje na minus pet, ali se vrat ne znoji kada jakna skida u toplom stepenistu. Kao grejač staje ispod ovratnika jakne, a kad vetar ojača navuče se i preko ušiju, kao traka za glavu.

Siva skriva prašinu i prskanje s puta bolje od crne, a dobro izgleda pored jakni u žarkoj boji. Kad ga ne nosiš, stane u bočni džep ranca. Lako se navlači i skida, brzo se suši i drži oblik posle pranja — svakodnevna oprema iz Tamir radnje.
en_title: Grey Men's Buff with Fleece Lining
en_description:
Grey men's buff with fleece lining for daily commutes: it sits under your collar, hides road dust and becomes a headband in wind.

Built for the commute loop: door, stop, ride, office, then the same route in reverse. Grey is the colour that hides road dust and winter spray, so the buff keeps looking tidy after weeks of use, and it plays well with brighter jackets without fighting them.

In transit it works as a neck warmer, sealed under a jacket collar so wind cannot sneak in; when the wind does find you, one pull covers ears and cheeks, and it settles back down the moment you are inside. Fleece lining adds warmth for stops and transfers without bulk under a coat.

title: Plavi muški buff sa flisom
description:
Plavi muški buff sa flisom: zimski akcenat koji se slaže sa mornarski plavom i sivom jaknom — na vrat, lice ili kao traka za glavu.

Šaren detalj u liniji svakodnevnih zimskih modela: plava lepo složi sa mornarski plavom, sivom i jaknama od džinsa, a ističe se iz mase crnih kapa ne upadajući u oči. Može se navući na vrat, na lice kada je jak vetar i na čelo kao traka za glavu tokom trčanja.

Flis podstava greje vrat u vlažne zimske dane, a materijal ne žuži pod ovratnikom jakne. Posle pranja zadržava boju i oblik, pa ostaje među najčešće nošenim komadima zimske opreme. Model iz Tamir radnje.
en_title: Blue Men's Buff with Fleece Lining
en_description:
Blue men's buff with fleece lining: a colour accent that pairs with navy and grey jackets, worn on the neck, face or as a headband.

The blue version is the accent piece in an otherwise dark winter line. It sits well next to navy parkas, grey coats and denim jackets, and stands out from a crowd of black hats without shouting. Like the other colours it pulls on without tying.

Wear it as a neck warmer, a face cover in hard wind, or a headband for a cold run. The fleece lining keeps the neck warm through damp winter days and never itches under a jacket collar, and it holds both colour and shape through repeated washes.
